items.title: Taiping Hospital’s Emergency Department Is Also Drowning — Medical Officer
items.summary: All zones in Taiping Hospital's emergency department are struggling with doctor shortages and overwhelming patient loads from referrals from district hospitals and KKs. items.title: Health Minister Should Have Paid His Last Respects To Sarawakian FDS Victims
items.summary: People remember who shows up.
